title: Club schedule and member services
source_note: Original ForLanguage content. User-provided recent-review notes were used only as topic-frequency signals. British Council materials were used only to verify public task format and word limits.

tasks.prompt: You have joined a community activity club. Reply briefly to five member messages.
tasks.review_note: Original ForLanguage task authored from recurring practice/review themes and checked against the public Aptis ESOL General Writing format; no official or recalled prompt copied verbatim.
questions: What activity do you enjoy most?
Which day do you usually attend?
Do you prefer mornings or evenings?
How do you travel to the club?
What service do you use most?

tasks.prompt: The club is reviewing its weekly timetable. Write a short message explaining which opening time is most convenient for you.
tasks.review_note: Original ForLanguage task authored from recurring practice/review themes and checked against the public Aptis ESOL General Writing format; no official or recalled prompt copied verbatim.

tasks.prompt: Members are discussing possible timetable and service changes.
tasks.review_note: Original ForLanguage task authored from recurring practice/review themes and checked against the public Aptis ESOL General Writing format; no official or recalled prompt copied verbatim.
questions: Which day should the club stay open longest?
What service should the club protect if costs rise?

tasks.prompt: The club announces that it will close every Sunday and start charging separately for a service that was previously included. Write to a friend about the changes and say what you think should happen.
